summary: Verified fix: rol 'usuario' ahora gestiona cirugías en Sala de Operaciones (view_sala_operaciones). Backend pytest 4/5 pass; UI end-to-end as 'usuario' 100% pass: 'Registrar cirugía' visible, created full surgery (Novavision, patient linked, surgeon, OD, anestesia General, anestesiólogo, obs) -> toast 'Cirugía registrada', appears in list; detail -> + Agregar equipo (Facoemulsificador) 'Equipo agregado', + Agregar insumo (Viscoelástico x2) 'Insumo agregado', Editar observaciones 'Cirugía actualizada' persisted (verified in DB); zero 4xx API responses. Cancel (X) and delete buttons NOT shown to usuario; cancel endpoint 403; DELETE 403. 'Editar datos del paciente' (form) and 'Editar paciente' (detail) links visible and open Editar Paciente modal (not saved, to avoid altering real data). usuario /auth/me: view_sala_operaciones=True, create_expenses/edit_expenses=False; POST /api/expenses 403. Superadmin regression: register btn, cancel btn visible, edit saves OK. ONE SECURITY GAP found: cancel restriction can be bypassed via PUT /api/surgeries/{id} with {status:'cancelado'}.

critical.issue: SurgeryUpdate model accepts status/cancellation_reason/rescheduled_to and update_surgery $sets them blindly. Any user with view_sala_operaciones (now incl. 'usuario', medico, anestesia) can cancel a surgery by PUT {"status":"cancelado","cancellation_reason":"x"} -> 200 and status persisted 'cancelado', bypassing the superadmin-only POST /cancel. Pre-existed for admin (had edit_expenses), but now widened to usuario. Reproduced by test_usuario_cannot_cancel_via_put.

minor.issue: Deletes anesthesia_records but leaves orphan db.notas_cirugia (clinical-history note auto-created when surgery is linked to a patient). Pre-existing; I manually removed the orphan note of my test surgery.

db.roles overrides merge on top of defaults. Preview has no db.roles doc for 'usuario', but if PRODUCTION has a customized 'usuario' doc in db.roles with view_sala_operaciones:false (e.g. saved via Roles UI), the code fix will NOT take effect in prod. Verify prod db.roles {name:'usuario'}.

Switching to view_sala_operaciones also grants create/edit surgeries to 'medico' (create_expenses was False -> previously 403 although UI showed buttons) and to 'anestesia' role (db.roles has view_sala_operaciones:true). Likely desired (aligns with UI), but confirm anestesia should be able to create/edit surgeries.

action_items: HIGH: In update_surgery, strip/forbid status, cancellation_reason, rescheduled_to (and related cancel fields) for non-superadmin (or remove from SurgeryUpdate and use only POST /cancel). Also ensure frontend edit form does not send them.
Check PRODUCTION db.roles for a 'usuario' override with view_sala_operaciones=false; if present the fix won't apply in prod (update that doc or via Roles UI).
Optional: delete_surgery should also delete db.notas_cirugia with surgery_id.
Optional: confirm intended access for 'anestesia' and 'medico' roles now able to create/edit surgeries.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate PERMISSIONS matrices in server.py and config/permissions.py already drift (view_audit_logs, admin manage_igss_units differ) — consolidate to a single source.
preop toggle button in detail dialog has no canEdit guard (harmless now since backend checks same permission).

success_rate.backend: 80% (4/5; failing test = cancel bypass via PUT)

seed_data_creation: None persisted. Test surgeries (TEST_Perm*, TEST_UI) deleted via superadmin; orphan notas_cirugia of UI surgery deleted by its surgery_id. Patient 'MARÍA TERESA MILIÁN ARGUETA' was linked but NOT modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rerun /app/backend/tests/test_surgeries_usuario_permissions.py (run with -p no:xdist -o addopts=''). After fix of PUT cancel bypass, test_usuario_cannot_cancel_via_put should pass. UI flow as usuario verified fully in iteration_126.
rca of the issue: Original bug: surgery write endpoints used require_permission('create_expenses'/'edit_expenses'); usuario/medico had those False -> 403 while frontend (canEdit=view_sala_operaciones) showed controls. Fix verified. New finding: PUT accepts status field enabling cancellation bypass.
